description: The pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of sixteen different categories. The segments are arranged clockwise in descending order of size, beginning from the top right. There is no separate legend; instead, labels and exact percentages are provided for the categories. The four largest slices feature their labels directly inside the segments: "date" (green, 19.30%), "from" (light blue, 17.00%), "to" (yellow, 14.50%), and "genre" (dark green, 13.50%). Continuing clockwise, the remaining smaller slices have external labels connected to their respective segments by thin lines. These include "name" (dark blue, 5.20%) and "size" (brown, 4.20%). Following the "size" segment is a light green slice that lacks a label and contains a grey rectangular visual artifact. The subsequent labeled slices are "intent" (light blue, 3.80%), "location" (yellow, 3.80%), "destination" (dark green, 3.00%), "city" (blue, 2.60%), "class" (ochre, 2.40%), "range" (light green, 2.20%), "type" (light blue, 2.00%), "beds" (pale yellow, 1.30%), and finally the smallest slice, "passengers" (dark green, 1.10%). None of the slices are exploded, offset, or bolded for visual emphasis.
